title: Number Link 2248
description: Swipe across chains of matching and escalating number bubbles in all eight directions to fuse massive combos and chase endlessly higher powers of two.
controls: Press and drag across adjacent matching number circles (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) to merge them into a larger number.

zh-CN.title: 数字连线 2248
zh-CN.description: 极度丝滑的 2248 数字连线合成：八方向一笔画串联相同及递增数字泡泡，瞬间合出超大倍数组合超级解压！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕上下左右及斜向滑动连接相邻相同数字，连得越长合成的数字倍数越高。
